messages.subject: action buttons and connecting to database
parts:
Hi,

I wanted to create a button which a user clicks to establish a connection to a database, such as MySQL using the RMySql package.

I have read data from databases by placing the code outside of the shiny server function before in the global environment and it has worked fine for me. I've also used action buttons before fine along with observeEvent.

this is the connection:
mydb=dbConnect(MySQL(), user='root',password='',dbname='xyz',host='localhost')

I would have thought printing this expression to the console would be good enough to run it but it doesn't work .

this is the expression in server.R
observeEvent( input$button,{
print(mydb=dbConnect(MySQL(), user='root',password='',dbname='xyz',host='localhost'))
})

this is the expression in UI.R

              actionButton("button",label= "Connect to a Database",icon= icon("database"))


Any suggestions would be great! Thanks.
